title: allophones
blurb: a clickable morphophonemic chart: pick a point of articulation and a vowel quality off the real ipa consonant and vowel tables, and get a syllable with a meaning generated from its own phonetics — every legal combination gets one, not just a hand-picked few. built for @words.bsky.social, off a thread about minting single-syllable words.
